issue.title: sase agent-cli update muse: smoke-test that --enable-shell-tool is still accepted and yields a synchronous shell tool
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-177.4 (epic sase-177; plan "Follow-ups" item 4). Epic sase-177
made SASE launch `muse exec` with `--enable-shell-tool` (flag muse_synchronous_shell,
default on; src/sase/llm_provider/muse.py). If a Muse release drops or changes that
flag, every Muse run fails with exit 2, or worse, silently regains managed `bash` with
its invisible post-turn wake.

In `sase agent-cli update muse`, after updating, smoke-test that `--enable-shell-tool`
is still accepted and still yields a synchronous `shell` tool with no managed `bash`
(for example via a tiny `muse exec --json` run or a tool-listing probe), and fail loudly
otherwise, pointing at `sase flag disable muse_synchronous_shell` as the rollback. This
also feeds the sase-178 removal gate ("no Muse release has dropped or changed
--enable-shell-tool").
